limitations_and_boundaries: PI-GANO's physics-informed training may suffer from small collocation point sampling for PDE residual computation, causing the model to overly focus on a small region and not always improve with more epochs.
The comparison with data-driven models is constrained by equal training times; data-driven models might outperform with extended training.
The study only considers two PDE problems (Darcy flow and 2D plate) with specific geometry variations; generalization to other PDEs or more complex geometries is not evaluated.
The model uses a consistent mesh resolution across all FEM results, focusing on geometry generalization rather than mesh generalization.

methods.name: PI-GANO
methods.protocol_description: Physics-Informed Geometry-Aware Neural Operator. Uses a geometry encoder to capture domain geometry features and integrates it within the Deep Compositional Operator Network architecture. Trained with physics-informed loss without any FEM data. Hyperparameters: Tanh activation, three operator layers of width 512, Adam optimizer (β1=0.9, β2=0.999), learning rate and coordinate sampling size ratio tuned via grid search from {0.001,0.0005,0.0002,0.0001} and {0.3,0.2,0.1,0.05}. Batch size 20 on NVIDIA P100 GPU.

methods.name: PI-PointNet
methods.protocol_description: Physics-informed PointNet. Original architecture without PDE parameter generalization. Uses three hidden layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer with same hyperparameters as PI-GANO.

methods.name: PI-PointNet*
methods.protocol_description: Modified PI-PointNet to include PDE parameter encoding by concatenating parameter values (or zeros if unavailable) with collocation point coordinates. Three hidden layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer.

methods.name: PI-DCON
methods.protocol_description: Physics-informed Deep Compositional Operator Network. Uses three operator layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer. Handles variable PDE parameters on a given irregular domain geometry but does not generalize across geometries.
